safety.importantNotice: Vital Loop is a coordination and discovery layer. It does not store, test, transport, release, distribute, or transfuse blood. Blood collection, testing, storage, compatibility decisions, release and transfusion remain with authorised blood centres and qualified healthcare professionals.
